name: com.github.mah-lib.addressable-manager
description: A module that manages Unity Addressables from loading to releasing in one place. Work with just LoadAsync / Release; anything you forget to release is reclaimed automatically when its lifetime (Manual / Scene / Owner) ends. Also includes initialization, download, loading by Label, and Editor tools for inspection.

samples.description: Check loading and releasing of Prefab, Sprite, Audio, and Label batches, together with the differences between lifetimes (Manual / Scene / Owner).
Check the initialization state transitions and how to receive completion and failure (await and events).
Check update checks, getting the download size, and downloading with progress.
